deck_text:
Tidewell: the operating system for independent clinics.

Problem. Independent physiotherapy and rehab clinics in the Nordics run on paper calendars, spreadsheets and a billing tool from 2009. The average clinic loses 14% of booked hours to no-shows and spends nine hours a week chasing invoices. Owners are clinicians, not administrators, and they feel every lost hour.

Solution. Tidewell is one subscription that covers online booking, automated reminders, insurance and subsidy billing, and a simple daily dashboard. Setup takes an afternoon. A clinic migrates its calendar by uploading a file; we handle the rest.

Traction. Tidewell is live in 38 clinics across Sweden and Denmark. The median no-show rate fell 31% in the first 90 days. Net revenue retention is 112% and gross margin is 78%. Annual recurring revenue is EUR 410k, with an average contract of EUR 9.4k per clinic per year. We have not lost a clinic to a competitor in the last two quarters.

Market. There are roughly 46,000 independent allied-health clinics in the Nordics and DACH. At our average contract that is a EUR 430M serviceable market, before payments.

Competition. Large practice-management suites target hospitals and charge for features small clinics never use. Generic booking apps ignore billing. Tidewell is built for the five-chair clinic.

Team. Three founders: a former clinic owner, a billing-systems engineer and a growth lead who ran sales at a scheduling company. Eleven combined years in clinic operations software.

Round. We are raising EUR 1.5M pre-seed on a SAFE to hire two engineers and a customer-success lead, and to open Germany. Plan: EUR 1.2M ARR by end of 2027.
